title: Integrated Realism

water.system: animated multi-direction water textures plus official Vibrant Visuals waves

material_fix: removed artificial RGB/rainbow procedural material generation and replaced it with physically coherent PBR palettes
notes: All profiles remain unlocked with memory_tier 1.
Reflections rely on the Bedrock renderer SSR/IBL path and material roughness/normal response.
The pack does not use fake unsupported PCSS, planar-reflection or custom TAA fields.
